source:
@@U00236@@
everyone shouting, great and small,
happy with life.
It’s here I feel, I dare to feel,
human again.

@@U00238@@
To take a stroll with you, Doctor,
is a real privilege, and a profit, too.
But I'd never choose to lose my way alone here,
sworn enemy of everything vulgar.
I look around at this fiddling, screaming,
bowling hubbub and think how detestable.
It’s a devil-driven riot, if you ask me,
and they call it pleasure, they call it song.

@@U00239@@
(PEASANTS sing and dance under the linden tree.)

@@U00241@@
The shepherd decked out in his Sunday best,
Ribbons flying and flowered vest,
Oh, what a sight was he!
Under the linden tree they danced,
Man and maid, how high they pranced.
Yoo-hoo! Yoo-ho!
And a hey-nonny-no!
And the fiddler played, yo-hee!
He pushed his way on into the swirl,
Dancing on up to the prettiest girl,
And jabbed her with his elbow.
The sturdy lass turned round and said:
“Howd you like a knock on the head?”
Yoo-hoo! Yoo-ho!
And a hey-nonny-no!
“Show some manners, you know?”
He danced in a circle and she held tight,
They danced to the left, they danced to the right,
And every skirt went flying.
translation:
@@U00236@@
每个人都在喊叫，无论大小，
对生活感到满意。
我在这里感受到，我敢于感受，
又是人类了。

@@U00238@@
和你一起散步，博士，
这是一种真正的特权，也是一种利润。
但我绝不会选择独自在这里迷失方向
一切庸俗事物的死敌。
我环顾四周，看着这些摆弄、尖叫的东西，
保龄球吵得沸沸扬扬，想想是多么可憎。
这是一场魔鬼驱动的骚乱，如果你问我，
他们称之为快乐，他们称之为歌曲。

@@U00239@@
（农民们在椴树下载歌载舞。）

@@U00241@@
牧羊人穿着他周日最好的衣服，
飘扬的丝带和花背心，
哦，他的景象多美啊！
他们在椴树下跳舞，
男人和女仆，他们跳得多高啊。
哟吼！哟呵！
还有一个嘿-老妈-不！
小提琴手演奏了，哟嘿！
他奋力冲进漩涡，
跟着最漂亮的女孩跳舞，
并用肘部戳了她一下。
壮硕的少女转过身来说道：
“你喜欢敲敲你的头吗？”
哟吼！哟呵！
还有一个嘿-老妈-不！
“表现得有礼貌，知道吗？”
他绕圈跳舞，她紧紧抱住，
他们向左跳舞，向右跳舞，
每条裙子都飞了起来。
